# Support

**This repository is for reporting bugs and contributing to Mahi. It is not a
support channel.**

Mahi is pre-1.0. For everything about *using* it, the answer is almost
certainly in the documentation:

- [Documentation](https://bradietilley.dev/mahi/dev-main) — the full manual
- [Installation](https://bradietilley.dev/mahi/dev-main/installation) — start here
- [Configuration](https://bradietilley.dev/mahi/dev-main/configuration) — config files and environment variables
- [Testing](https://bradietilley.dev/mahi/dev-main/testing) — if your app will not start, test it in isolation first

## Before you ask anywhere

1. Search the [existing issues](https://github.com/mahiframework/mahi/issues) —
   it is a small project, your question is probably already answered.
2. Search the documentation for the framework's area — Container, Providers,
   Routing, Database, Auth, Queue, and the rest each have a page.
3. If you are stuck on your own application rather than on the framework, that is
   a bug in your app, not in Mahi.

## Questions

Ask questions in
[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/mahiframework/mahi/discussions), or open a
[Stack Overflow question](https://stackoverflow.com/help/tagging) tagged
`mahiframework` if you would rather have it searchable by other people.

Include:

- the Mahi version, from your `package.json` or `node scripts/set-version.mjs --print`
- your Node.js version (`node --version`)
- the smallest snippet that shows what you expected versus what happened

## Bug reports

If it is a defect in the framework itself, open an issue using the
[bug report template](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml). Do not use
Discussions for bugs.

## Commercial support

There is none. Mahi has one maintainer and no support contract.
